notes.subject: ol i no ken lusim pikinini insait bel
notes.rationale: משכלה em i tok bilong lusim pikinini; Hibru i no tok 'meri', tok i toktok long sampela samting

notes.subject: מספר ימיך
notes.rationale: kaunim bilong ol de — namba bilong laip

translation: Sikspela samting i no ken stap: ol i no ken lusim pikinini insait bel, na ol i no ken no gat pikinini, long graun bilong yu; ⟨את⟩ namba bilong ol de bilong yu mi bai pulimapim.
